name: Light Affinity
description: You can focus and refract beams of light to protect your allies and hamper your foes. Your Beams of light can charge up to Radiant Beams, casting new effects on everyone in range.

powers.name: Protective Beam
powers.description:
Casts a protective beam of light around an ally, encasing them in a thin, prismatic barrier that absorbs enemy hits. The beam then refracts off this barrier, coating all allies around your target and increasing their defense against all damage for some time.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will apply an additional layer of Absorb on all allies.

powers.name: Blinding Beam
powers.description:
Casts a brilliant beam of light at your enemy, holding them in place with a dazzling layer of light. This beam then refracts off this layer, lowering the chance to hit and perception of all targets for some time.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will apply an additional, harsh debuff to ToHit and Damage.

powers.name: Radiance
powers.description:
You concentrate your powers, and emit even more powerful light from yourself! While under the effects of Radiance, you and your allies will immediately recover Endurance, then get a large boost to Damage and ToHit, as well as unlock Radiance Bonuses on all other Light Affinity powers for 20 seconds.

Additionally, you and your allies will gain a slightly weaker boost to Damage and ToHit, as well as ToHit debuff resistance, Perception, and Perception debuff resistance that lingers beyond the Radiance Bonus.

powers.name: Purifying Beam
powers.description:
You shine light on your ally to cleanse them of their wounds. This beam then refracts off this cleansing layer, increasing the resistance to Energy and Negative Energy damage of all allies around your target by filtering incoming attacks through the cleansing light.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will apply an additional Heal to all allies.

powers.name: Lightfield
powers.description:
You emit a radiant field of light that emboldens and protects you and your allies that bathe in it. Allies inside this field will gain a constant, stacking amount of absorption. Lightfield also protects allies from Immobilization, Disorient, and Hold effects.

Allies will retain bonuses from Lightfield for some time after leaving the field's area.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will apply an additional buff to Regeneration to yourself and all allies.

powers.name: Magnify
powers.description:
You concentrate your powers and create a lens around your ally, magnifying their Damage, Crowd Control strength, Radius of AoEs, Power Range, and the strength of Heals and Absorb used on them. This lens also increases their resistance to all damage by filtering incoming attacks through the lens.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will produce a powerful heal from your location, effecting yourself and all allies.

powers.name: Searing Beam
powers.description:
Fire an intense beam of light that burns your target, leaving them with reduced regeneration and secondary effect strength for some time. This beam then refracts around this burning light, causing minor Fire Damage Over Time and lowering the Damage Resistance of all targets. This searing light is especially damaging vs Undead targets.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will deal additional Fire Damage Over Time.
powers.shortHelp: Ranged Foe -Regeneration, -Special, -Res (DMG), Fire DoT, Special vs. Undead

powers.name: Spotlight
powers.description:
Select an ally to be bathed in a constant column of light! While under the spotlight, incoming attacks will be deflected by continuous absorption, their wounds will be mended, and crowd control effects will be shrugged off. Additionally, debuffs against your target will be much weaker and your ally's taunt effects will be strengthened.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will apply an additional Damage Buff to your target.
powers.shortHelp: Toggle: Ally, +Absorb over time, +Heal over time, +Res (Mez, Knock, Debuff),+Str (Taunt)

powers.name: Prismatic Shield
powers.description:
You summon a protective sphere of light, creating a shield for yourself and allies. Your defense and resistance vs all damage and defense debuffs is greatly increased while inside the shield. Enemies inside the Prismatic Shield will deal reduced damage.

Radiance:
Under the effects of Radiance, this power will apply an additional, brief Hold to all enemies in range that can overcome weak foes.
powers.shortHelp: Summon Prismatic Shield, Ally (+Def, +Res (DMG, Def)), Foe -DMG
